g.text: Every binary-operation-preserving map between the two final algebras is constant.
Proof: RECEIVERS.md, Theorems 4–6; every arrow is the specified universal map, not an inclusion.
Starting construction: HI-AI [1], §3. Identifications shown here are quotient outcomes, not changes to G(R).
